description: K₂Na₂Gd₄Nb₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.30 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.33 Å. There are two inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.47 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.57 Å. Nb is bonded to five O atoms to form NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent GdO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.02 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Gd atoms to form OGd₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent OGd₄ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Gd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OGd₄ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Gd, and one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Gd, and one Nb atom to form corner-sharing ONaGd₂Nb tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Gd, and one Nb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Gd, and one Nb atom.
